name: AFTER L!FE: Sowoneul Damneun Manhwagyeo
source:
A place unlike the Human Realm, "The Otherworld".
To manage these twenty odd, lovable, and sometimes dazzling Soul Reapers(!) is my duty! To fulfill their deepest desires, my Reapers are hard at work even now!

A new Manager joins the Soul Reapers!
Former pop idols to angels from heaven!
These 20 Reapers of varying ages, walks of life, and time periods rely on YOU, their manager, to lead them to a bright future!

Everyone has experiences that led them to the afterlife!
Enjoy the beautiful artwork and powerful episodes of these Reapers, comparable to anime, manga, and light novels!

These grim reapers do not only go after wayward souls and vengeful spirits! They clean their dorms, prune the orchards, patrol the grounds, and post on Social Media. A day in their life is jam PACKED!
translation:
与人界不同的地方，“异世界”。
管理这二十个可爱的、有时令人眼花缭乱的死神（！）是我的职责！为了实现他们最深切的愿望，我的收割者们现在仍在努力工作！

新任经理加入灵魂收割者！
从前的流行偶像到天堂天使！
这20位不同年龄、不同行业、不同时期的收割者依靠你，他们的经理，带领他们走向光明的未来！

每个人都有通往来世的经历！
享受这些收割者的精美艺术作品和强大的情节，堪比动画、漫画和轻小说！

这些死神不仅仅追捕任性的灵魂和复仇的灵魂！他们打扫宿舍，修剪果园，巡逻场地，并在社交媒体上发帖。他们生命中的一天是忙碌的！
